js-query-all.name: Only change to the first item

js-dataset.name: Read the dataset from event.target, but cannot get the attributes when clicking the text in the button

js-event-flow.name: If capture is omitted, the parent capture callback also runs in the bubbling phase.

js-remove-listener.name: gives removeEventListener a new arrow function, and the original listener is still there

js-form-data.name: Use get to keep only the first checked value

js-custom-validity.name: is only updated when entering in the confirmation box. The error remains after modifying the original password.

js-template-clone.name: When generating repeatedly, add the card after the old list

js-dom-remove.name: Only uses matches to detect the actual click target. It is invalid when clicking on the text inside the button.

js-dialog-focus.name: uses show(), it is not a modal window after opening

js-debounce-input.name: starts a new timer every time, resulting in multiple searches in a short period of time

js-storage-remove.name: uses clear to clear the user's other preferences.
